value.rationale: Complete invariant of a canonical finite dynamical benchmark: IEEE binary16 and logistic r=4. Algebraically equivalent real expressions yield completely different eventual cycle structure and basin partitions. The 8657 nonfixed-basin members in the expanded map vs 117 for one-round exact evaluation change the practical interpretation of deterministic low-precision chaos, beyond a textbook note that floats are nonassociative; exactly covers all 15361 natural states instead of cherry-picked initial values.
